description: Add a Pet Simulator 1 style lobby/spawn island before Zone 1. Includes circular spawn platform, decorative elements (fountain, benches, lamp posts), portal/archway leading to Zone 1, leaderboard display, quest board, and shop stand.
steps: Add _spawnLobby() function to ZoneService.lua called from init()
Create lobby floor platform (100x1x100, circular aesthetic) centered at X=-150, Z=-100
Move SpawnLocation from (0,2,0) to lobby position
Add decorative elements: fountain/statue center, benches, lamp posts
Add portal/archway leading to Zone 1 with sign 'Zone 1: Gruene Wiesen'
Add leaderboard display (Part with SurfaceGui placeholder)
Add quest board and shop stand (decorative)
Update generate_rbxlx.py to add lobby floor baseplate and move SpawnLocation
Update barrier logic to include lobby area
acceptance_criteria: Lobby spawns at X=-150, Z=-100 before Zone 1
SpawnLocation is on the lobby platform (not inside Zone 1)
Decorative elements exist: fountain, benches, lamps, portal archway
Portal has a sign indicating Zone 1
BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx regenerates successfully with lobby baseplate
verification: python3 -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ET.parse('BATTLE_PETS.rbxlx'); print('valid');"
findings: Lobby island implemented at X=-150, Z=-100 with 100x100 marble platform. SpawnLocation moved to lobby. Portal archway at right edge of lobby (X=-100) connects seamlessly to Zone 1. Barriers updated to cover lobby area and fix east wall placement (now on zone 8 instead of zone 2). Build generates valid XML (396KB, 77 items).
